desc_en: Designed for the modern woman who demands performance without compromising style. This cropped hoodie combines precise proportions with a clean silhouette. Each piece is made to order to ensure absolute exclusivity and a reduced environmental footprint. The minimalist aesthetic reflects confidence and sophistication in any environment. Ideal for completing a dynamic wardrobe with a touch of timeless elegance. Worldwide shipping available.
